name: TCL Mega Smash 2026
rules_note: Sources: TCL HT League Handbook 2025 (Championship, Promotion and Relegation Playoff Structure, pp. 7-9; 16.10.5 points and tie-breaks; 16.10.8 net run rate) with the 2026 Mega Smash change document, which does not change any of these. Points 2 / 1 / 1 / 0 also reproduce CricHeroes' points column (the rows that differ carry organiser penalties).
table_note: The played half of each table is seeded from the points table CricHeroes publishes, and this project's arithmetic is applied only to the fixtures still to come. Two things in the published table cannot be derived from the fixture list: organiser points penalties, which no endpoint exposes (RTP ThunderBolts, Greensboro Cricket Club HT, PATRIOTS, Carolina Wildcats and Royal Bengal Tigers - HT all sit below their win/loss record), and a handful of innings CricHeroes counts as all out at eight or nine wickets, knowing squad sizes we cannot see.
